metadata.description: Digital marketing system for Claude Code — a team of specialist agents (strategy, content, paid media, lifecycle, analytics) + skills for planning and running campaigns. Switch into it via profile 'marketing'.

plugins.name: mkt-core

plugins.name: mkt-content

plugins.name: mkt-paid

plugins.name: mkt-lifecycle

plugins.name: mkt-analytics
